value.description: Uploads a resumable session's video file, or a chunk of it, to the session URI a resumable videos.insert answered in its Location header; an empty request with Content-Range bytes */TOTAL asks how much has arrived.

201.description: The whole file arrived: the video resource that was created

308.description: Resume Incomplete: the Range header names the bytes already uploaded

patches.why: The Discovery document names videos.insert's resumable protocol but not the session's own requests: the resumable upload guide's step 3 uploads the file with a PUT to the session URI the step 1 POST answered, and step 4.1 checks an interrupted upload with an empty PUT there.

patches.why: The Discovery document's auth.oauth2 scopes, as an OpenAPI OAuth 2.0 scheme: the conversion keeps them as x-discovery-auth only, so no operation could name its scopes as security. Beside it, ApiKey: the key parameter every method takes, which the list methods that read public data accept in place of a token.
